acceptance_criteria.criterion: After exact-head candidate admission succeeds for a safe same-repository Draft PR, the trusted controller must perform Draft→Ready using the existing narrow mutation token, then confirm open/non-Draft/exact-head/base/node state by fresh read. Any historical regression expecting owner-only Ready must be updated to the canonical automatic-admission contract; ambiguous mutation without confirmed Ready fails closed. Merge approval remains separate and manual.
